_comment: Prepared from scenario-iso-cycles. Templates only: Scenario MCP was not connected; no model ids, paid calls, jobs or assets were fabricated. Body sprites have empty hands; weapons are separate runtime layers. Original prototype sheets are assets/*.png.
style: crisp hand-placed 16-bit pixel art, 1px dark forest outline, 24-colour earthy palette, muted moss green and warm parchment accents, soft top-left lighting, compact readable silhouettes

ranger.character: a compact ruin ranger in a moss-green hood and short cloak, tan leather tunic, ochre trim, dark boots, a square field satchel centred on the back; both hands empty for modular game weapons
ranger.back: we see the back of the headwear and coat, and the centred back-pack or emblem
ranger.extra: , coat hems and straps sway subtly
ranger.idle: the chest breathes softly and the coat hem moves by one pixel
ranger.attack: unarmed modular attack pose: pulls the leading arm back, quickly swings or thrusts the empty hands forward in the facing direction, follows through, then returns to the ready pose; do not invent a held weapon

attack_facing.s: a head-on empty-hand strike straight toward the viewer; both shoulders remain symmetrical, never turns side-on
attack_facing.n: an empty-hand strike straight away from the viewer; spine remains centred and the back stays fully visible

ranger.back_view: the back of the headwear and coat, with any pack or emblem staying centred
ranger.notes: Both hands are empty. Symmetric silhouette and centred equipment allow horizontal mirroring without swapping weapon hands. Game weapons are composited separately.

turn_notes.e: A strict right-facing profile; pack appears behind the body on the left of the image.
turn_notes.s: Exact front view, both shoulders level, empty hands equally visible, face and chest on the vertical centre line.
turn_notes.n: Exact rear view; the headwear, spine and back-pack or emblem share the same vertical centre line.
